def transform(grid):
    # Replicate the rare-color stencil at locations where all stencil cells
    # overlay the background color 0; preserve the source stencil and noise.
    src = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(src), len(src[0])
    color = next((v for row in src for v in row if v not in (0, 9)), None)
    if color is None:
        return out
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if src[r][c] == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts}
    sh, sw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if (r, c) == (r0, c0):
                continue
            if all(src[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
PY
